transcript: Welcome back to Tell Me More, a podcast series featuring distinguished visitors to Tufts University who share their ideas, discuss their work, and shed light on important topics of the day. The week before the death of President George H.W. Bush, Tufts University's Chris Swan spoke with former New Hampshire Governor John Sununu, who served as President Bush's Chief of Staff from 1989 to 1991. He recalls how President Bush met voters over breakfast at McDonald's, Denny's, Dunkin' Donuts, sometimes as many as five restaurants in a single morning. And looking ahead, Sununu considers the crowded field of Democratic candidates for the 2020 presidential campaign and whether a Republican should challenge President Trump for the GOP nomination. Let's listen in.
